programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Munks help a world-famous runner in 'Run Aimee Run', then in 'Theo vs Simon', Theodore embarks on a quest to find one thing he can do better than Simon, but it won't be so easy.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore must prove he's got the right stuff in 'Lost in Space...Camp', then in 'Super Hot Chocolate', Theodore loses his sense of taste.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Simon moves into a tree for some alone time in 'Back To Basics', then in 'Report Cards', Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything to catch the mail before Dave sees it.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave enforces strict study rules after Alvin blames him for bad grades in 'Alvin Gets Schooled', then in 'My Life As a Dog', Theodore acts as a dog.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin pretends to write a broadway show in 'Writer's Blocked', and in 'Jinxed!', after Theodore sees Alvin accidentally ruin Dave's computer, Alvin jinxes Theodore so he can't tell on him.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleep-overs in 'Theo's Big Night Out', then in 'The Bodyguard', Alvin decides he needs a personal bodyguard, and trains Theodore for the job.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety in 'The Karate Kidder', then in 'Playing Favourites', Alvin and Theo challenge Simon to a go-cart race.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise The Chipmunks in 'The App', then in 'Don Juan Theodoro', Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating tips.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks help mend a friendship in 'Summer Camp', and in 'Blabber Mouth', Alvin thinks that Theodore has cursed him to never lie again, and can't help himself from blabbing the truth.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin and Simon have a secret club in 'Mysterions', and in 'The Crow That Ate My Homework', Dave promises to take Alvin to a park if he gets a good grade on his test, but a crow steals it.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore struggles to do good deeds in 'Knights', and then in 'Snake Charmer', Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him in 'Brittany the Body Snatcher', and in 'Agent Smith', to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story ever seen.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in 'Artsy Smartsy', then in 'The Crush', Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gets roped into doing Alvin's job in 'Adventures in Babysitting', then in 'Alvin's Assistant', Kevin agrees to be Alvin's assistant but ends up running errands instead.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy".

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin suffers another implausible miscommunication in 'Party Animals', and then in 'Warren Seville', Theodore invents a new imaginary friend.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest in 'The Gift', and then in 'Theo Knows Best', when Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has ideas on how the money should be spent.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies in 'Members Only', then in 'The New Kid', Alvin befriends a lonely new kidl, but the new student may not be who he says he is.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: The Chipmunks take in a stray dog, but must keep the puppy hidden from Dave in 'Dog Days', then in 'Dragon Dad', Theodore orders a dragon egg in the hopes of it hatching into a real dragon.
